postings.title: Tax Analyst
postings.text:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance. WHOOP empowers users to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

We are seeking a Tax Analyst to join our Tax team and support our growing global tax function. As a key member of the team, you will help support indirect tax compliance, registrations, audits, and special projects across the U.S. and international jurisdictions.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong analytical foundation who enjoys working with data, solving complex problems, and learning new concepts. We are looking for a smart, detail-oriented professional who can develop expertise in indirect tax while helping build scalable processes and controls as WHOOP continues to grow.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Support the global indirect tax compliance process, including U.S. sales and use tax, VAT, GST, and other international indirect taxes

 - Analyze large datasets to support tax filings, reconciliations, audits, and special projects

 - Prepare and review data used in tax returns and ensure information is complete and accurate

 - Assist with tax registrations and ongoing compliance requirements in domestic and international jurisdictions

 - Support indirect tax audits, notices, refund claims, and tax authority inquiries

 - Partner with Accounting, Finance, Operations, and external service providers to gather information and resolve issues

 - Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen controls, and automate recurring tasks

 - Assist with maintaining tax systems, reporting tools, and data workflows

 - Take ownership of assigned projects and independently investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 1-3 years of experience in public accounting, tax, audit, consulting, or a related analytical role

 - Big 4 experience strongly preferred

 - CPA license or progress towards CPA license preferred

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field

 - Advanced Excel skills with experience working with large datasets

 - Experience with Alteryx, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar data analytics tools is a plus

 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities

 - Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

 - Curiosity and willingness to learn new tax concepts and business processes

 - Experience with NetSuite, Stripe, Avalara, or other ERP and tax systems is a plus



This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

 

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify  https://www.e-verify.gov/to determine employment eligibility

 

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

 

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

 

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $65,000 - $90,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

 

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.



These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

postings.title: Staff Accountant
postings.text:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and extend healthspan. Through continuous health and performance monitoring, WHOOP empowers members to better understand their bodies and make informed decisions that improve their daily lives.

As a Staff Accountant, Corporate Accounting, you will play a key role in supporting the accuracy, integrity, and scalability of WHOOP's financial operations. You will support critical areas of the month-end close process, including fixed assets, accruals, prepaid expenses, expense management, and balance sheet reconciliations. This role offers broad exposure across the organization through partnerships with Marketing, Manufacturing, Legal, Operations, R&D, and Finance teams. This is an excellent opportunity to build a strong technical foundation, gain a deep understanding of WHOOP's business operations, and grow within a high-performing accounting team.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, and eager to learn, with a passion for problem-solving and leveraging technology to improve efficiency.

This role is based in Boston, MA. Candidates must be willing to relocate, if necessary, to work from our Boston office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Support the month-end close process through the preparation of journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, and monthly fluctuation analyses, helping ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial results.

 - Support the monthly marketing accrual process by gathering inputs from Marketing stakeholders and preparing accrual calculations related to campaigns, agency relationships, and partnerships with high-profile athletes, influencers, and brand ambassadors.

 - Maintain fixed asset accounting, including recording asset additions, placements, transfers, disposals, and monthly depreciation, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and R&D teams to support capital expenditure initiatives.

 - Prepare prepaid expense schedules and monthly amortization entries, reviewing vendor contracts and invoices to help ensure costs are recorded over the appropriate benefit period.

 - Support company-wide expense management processes, helping ensure accurate reporting, policy compliance, and scalable controls.

 - Support annual audits and quarterly reviews by preparing schedules and supporting documentation and assisting with responses to auditor inquiries.

 - Contribute to process improvement and finance transformation initiatives by supporting system implementations, documenting standard operating procedures, and leveraging automation and AI-driven solutions to enhance efficiency.

QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

 - 1-3 years of accounting experience; public accounting experience is a plus

 - Foundational understanding of U.S. GAAP and core accounting principles.

 - CPA candidacy or interest in pursuing the CPA is a plus.

 - Strong Excel skills, with comfort working with large datasets.

 - Experience with NetSuite, Oracle, or a comparable ERP system is a plus.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with intellectual curiosity and a willingness to ask questions and learn.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

 - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and motivated by continuous improvement and process optimization.

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company's long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $60,000 -$90,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate's specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role's requirements.

postings.title: FP&A Manager
postings.text:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring an FP&A Manager to serve as the finance business partner to our rapidly growing Wholesale organization. In this role, you will partner closely with Wholesale leadership to drive forecast accuracy, inform key commercial decisions, and improve the efficiency and profitability of the channel through disciplined financial planning, margin management, and analysis. You will bring together detailed financial modeling and strategic thinking to provide greater visibility into business performance while helping strengthen the finance infrastructure and processes that support the continued growth of Wholesale at WHOOP.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Serve as the Finance business partner to the Wholesale organization, providing actionable financial and strategic insights to drive growth, efficiency, and profitability

 - Own and enhance financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and re-forecasting for Wholesale, including revenue, units, gross margin, and key operational drivers across retailers and products

 - Drive forecast accuracy and accountability by identifying key variances, risks, and opportunities and translating evolving business performance into an updated financial outlook

 - Own and optimize wholesale margin management and channel economics, maintaining visibility into retailer profitability and identifying opportunities to improve financial performance

 - Leverage and refine financial models and analytical frameworks to inform key commercial decisions, including new retailer partnerships, geographic expansion, pricing and promotions, and assortment strategy

 - Support the transition to an EPM system and continued maturation of core finance infrastructure, implementing process and reporting improvements that increase scalability, accuracy, and structure as the business grows

QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, consulting, or another highly analytical finance role

 - Strong financial modeling and forecasting skills, with demonstrated ability to translate business performance into forward-looking plans and actionable insights

 - Strong understanding of revenue, gross margin, and channel economics, including the impact of pricing, product mix, promotions, and other drivers of profitability

 - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets; experience with EPM systems, SQL, Python, or other analytical tools is a plus

 - Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to identify key business drivers, evaluate tradeoffs, and inform complex decisions

 - Highly effective, unbiased communicator with the ability to adapt communication style to different audiences. Can articulate complex data clearly to a diverse range of stakeholders.

 - Highly proactive and self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and able to identify opportunities, take initiative, and drive projects forward.

 - Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions
